description: X/Y pad: drag in the grid to put out a pair of voltages, and the gesture is recorded and played back a step per clock

params.text: When on, playback returns to the start of the recorded gesture once the end is reached; when off, playback stops at the end
When on, dragging in the grid overwrites the recording from the playback point onward instead of starting a new one, and playback carries on when the mouse is released

inputs.text: A rising edge moves playback to the next recorded position; with nothing patched here the outputs follow the mouse directly
A rising edge returns playback to the first recorded position

outputs.text: The horizontal position, rising to the right
The vertical position, rising towards the top

notes: pressing in the grid starts a new recording and releasing starts playback of what was drawn
while a clock is patched the outputs run 0-10V whatever the Output Range setting says
menu: Output Range — the span of both outputs, from -10.0 to 10.0 down to 0.0 to 1.0, with 0.0 to 10.0 to start with; honoured only while CLK is unpatched, despite the menu offering it either way
Tablet Mode — moves the point by hovering over the grid, with no button held

inputs.0: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
